1. PREMISE: Your framing treats this as a problem of broken promises and unfair distribution of effort, but the actual situation is a fundamental incompatibility of life trajectories. The hidden assumption is that negotiation, persuasion, or restructured expectations can restore the original agreement. The analysis turns on recognizing that no revision of terms can resolve what is now visible: he has chosen a permanent life structure that is materially incompatible with the commitments you made.

2. STAKES: You stand to lose years of earning potential you already sacrificed, ongoing financial hemorrhage, physical and psychological deterioration from unsustainable labor, foreclosure of family-building timelines, and the erosion of your own future stability. He stands to lose housing, financial security, and access to a partner whose respect he has destroyed. Any children born into this arrangement stand to inherit dependency as a model and financial precarity as their baseline. Your employer stands to receive labor from an increasingly depleted person. Your creditors stand to receive payments only so long as your body sustains the load. The tech industry stands to gain access to someone he will never pursue despite possessing qualifications.

3. DIRECTIVE: End this partnership immediately and initiate separation. His stated priorities have rendered the foundational agreement void, and his hostility when confronted signals he will not alter course regardless of consequences—to you or to him.
[Rejected path: Restructure household finances and propose new timelines for his employment advancement. This produces continued extraction of your labor, false hope that negotiation can overcome settled preference, and your eventual physical collapse or financial ruin; probability of primary harm: high.]

4. RECOMMENDATION: Separate your finances and housing without delay. The mechanism by which continued cohabitation produces worse outcomes is straightforward: every month you remain increases your financial exposure, deepens the sunk-cost reasoning that keeps you trapped, and normalizes his dependency as a permanent condition rather than a crisis to be exited. His hostility when pressed is not a sign that better communication will help—it is evidence that he experiences your claim on him as illegitimate and intolerable. The competing claim that you are "otherwise happy" is outweighed by a single fact: he has told you, directly and without ambiguity, that his leisure takes priority over your survival. Therefore: initiate separation proceedings, secure independent housing and finances, and cease all financial support for him immediately.
